Implement a **decentralized adaptive fluid circulation network** integrated with the existing two-phase immersion cooling rack, featuring:
- **Localized heat sinks** (copper-aluminum composite plates, 5 mm thickness) installed at rack hotspots, spaced **15 cm apart** along the fluid flow path — (ASSUMPTION — value not stated in the cited record)- **Dynamic fluid redistribution valves** (electro-pneumatic, 0.5–2.0 L/min flow range) triggered by **rack inlet temperature >55°C** — ASSUMPTION (derived from ASHRAE Class A3 allowable limit of 50°C + 5°C safety margin)
- **Centralized heat recovery loop** (plate-and-frame heat exchanger, 10 kW capacity) tied to a **secondary dielectric fluid circuit** (mineral oil, 30 cSt viscosity) — (ASSUMPTION — value not stated in the cited record)- **Adaptive circulation pump array** (variable-speed, 0–3000 RPM) with **PID control** tuned to maintain **fluid velocity <0.3 m/s** in high-density zones — ASSUMPTION (based on dielectric fluid breakdown threshold for mineral oil at 70 kW/rack)

- **Sample size (n)**: 3 identical racks with installed system.
- **Pass/fail criteria**: **≥95% of measurements ≤52°C** (ASHRAE Class A2 limit). If **>5% exceed 52°C**, reject proposal.
